title: Raw results route refuses run directories carrying non-link Windows reparse points (OneDrive/Cloud Files) as redirected
outcome: On Windows, the raw results route refuses only name-surrogate (symlink/junction) reparse directories, or synced folders are documented as unsupported for it; non-link reparse directories no longer yield 422 test_run_results_redirected.
acceptance: Raw results route refuses run directories carrying non-link Windows reparse points (OneDrive/Cloud Files) as redirected is done
